text: CONTEXT.md's Established section is stale and is now misinforming every role on every call. Its opening caveat still says 'the workspace ledger CLAIMS.md is empty; code/ has no programs and code/out/ has no captures' and marks the sieve/oracle facts as recalled-not-this-run-verified. That was true at minute 10 and is false now: research/CLAIMS.md holds 20+ claims, code/erdos/ holds oracle.py and dh_classifier.py, and code/out/oracle_verify.captured.txt verifies the witnesses, |A_k|=2^(k-1) to k=26 by three agreeing routes, and digit-free n in [0,1000] = {2,8}. Have context_curator rewrite that section against what is actually on disk: drop the caveat, mark the re-verified items with their capture file and bound, and add what this run established since — the vacuous-bounded-UNSAT finding, the C1/C2 refutations, the reflection-invariance refutation (k=2..26), the mod-3^j injectivity (j=1..12), the inverse-digit-2 identity, and the Dimitrov-Howe Lemma 3.1 reading that explains |A_k|=2^(k-1) as its degenerate M=3^k instance. Keep every evidence class exact.

Resolve the determinacy MISMATCH in code/out/dh_gate_independent.captured.txt cheaply and write the answer to disk, then move on. Analysis to check against, not to trust: the criterion 'p^i is determinate mod M iff i < v_p(M)' appears CORRECT, and the spot-check's comparison appears inverted or mislabelled. For M=5440=2^6*85 the powers of 2 have tail=6, so i=0..5 are determinate and i>=6 indeterminate, which is exactly i < v_2(M)=6; the reported rows (5440,2,6,False),(5440,2,7,False),(5440,2,8,False) are all i>=v_2 and False is the right answer for them. For M=81, v_2(81)=0 so no power of 2 is determinate; ord_81(2)=54 means 2^0 repeats at b=54, so i=0,1,2 -> False is also right. So the rows labelled MISMATCH look like agreements being printed under a mismatch header. Fix the spot-check's comparison (or its label), re-run, and record the outcome as a checked claim with the capture path. Do NOT re-verify the M1/M2 verdicts - they already PASS by two independent routes. If instead the criterion really is wrong, that is a defect in code/erdos/dh_classifier.py's Definition 2.2 restatement and the whole bertok-hajdu approach rests on it, so say so explicitly in research/approaches/bertok-hajdu-cross-modulus-ladder.md. Either way, land the result as a file within this attempt rather than carrying it in reasoning.
